description: Normalised components/presets common to the three motion styles, with per-style parameter overrides, so one renderer can drive Ember Glass (style-1), Teal Spatial Glass (style-2) and Crimson Halo Glass (style-3).

conventions.px: px on the 1080x1920 render canvas (= 720x1280 reference measurement x1.5)
conventions.px720: keys ending in 720 hold the raw reference measurement in 720x1280 px
conventions.pct: keys ending in Pct are % of canvas width (x) or height (y); identical at 720 and 1080
conventions.frames: keys ending in F (durationF, startOffsetF, tF ...) are frames at 30 fps, the render rate
conventions.colour: #RRGGBB (uppercase) or rgba(); gradients are CSS strings
conventions.keyframes: list of objects with tMs (optional tF) plus the animated property name
conventions.gainDb: dB relative to full scale for the engine mixer (audio.py)
conventions.layers: engine layer names: bg | behind | front | fx (plateWrap / talentWrap for the camera targets)
conventions.merge: resolved params = component.defaults <- styles[styleId] <- styles[styleId].variants[variant] <- cue.props (later wins)
conventions.refs: refs / ref are JSON pointers "styles/style-N/style.json#/<section>/<id>"; ids are matched on the id (or role for fonts) field
conventions.disabled: styles[styleId].enabled === false means the style does not use this component; use `substitute` if given
conventions.start: start = {anchor: cut | hero | heroDone | prevLine | pill | component | phrase | ring | interrupt | heroLine | oldWord, offsetMs (negative = before)}

director.note: srt2scene only drafts. Assign per-shot hero materials, components and the pull-back by hand using the narrative template in STYLE.md.

fontLatin.use: wordmark and ghost echo (same family as the Arabic); Inter 500 only for the red UI chip

style-3.accentCoolNote: only produced by Difference blend; never a fill

director.note: srt2scene's punch logic is disabled: this style never pushes in. Add the 4 pull-backs by hand (hook x2, breather, brand).

components.purpose: Frosted stadium (radius = height/2) that backs a key line, a name tag, a search field or a CTA. Present in all three styles; only the material numbers change.

params.innerField: optional dark inner capsule {widthPx, heightPx, radiusPx, insetPx, side, fill}
params.autosize: width follows the typed text (paddingXPx each side)

style-1.rules: Sits in front of the talent with the hands visible (frosted) through it. Every capsule except the clear pills carries a capsule-button.

style-2.rules: Apple / visionOS material: heavy backdrop blur (18-26 px), 1.5-3 px specular top edge. Gold light from the hero spills into the pill.

style-3.rules: Smoked glass darkens 10-14% and blurs 5-10 px; the hero overlaps the pill top edge by about 38 px and stays crisp. No arrow button (a red outline bell may sit inside the small pill).

components.purpose: Round arrow button inside a capsule (the "tap here" cue).

style-3.reason: Style 3 capsules are plain smoked or hairline glass; there is no arrow button.
style-3.substitute: bell-ring icon (72x63 px, 4.5 px #FF030F outline, sways ±11°) inside the small smoked pill: styles/style-3/style.json#/graphicComponents/bell-ring

components.purpose: How a capsule is born: from a glass ring, a bead or a small seed, stretched into the final stadium (never a plain fade).

stretch.anchor: right side mostly fixed: left edge overshoots and returns, right edge drifts +105px

seedStretch.note: pill1 stretches left first then pops to full; pill2 grows from the centre in 240 ms

components.purpose: Large glass shape that adds depth: it bends, frosts or frames the type beneath it. Each style has one signature shape.

style-1.rules: Refraction: the interior magnifies (1.2x) or displaces and blurs the captions beneath; the payoff word sits above the rings and is not refracted.

build.material: neutral grey glass 10-20% white + strong backdrop blur; talent's hands visible blurred through the window

dock.note: No own animation. The camera pull-back reveals it from the left edge.

style-2.rules: Spatial-app glass in perspective; neutral grey glass 10-20% white plus strong blur; hands show through.

contents.zOrder: on top of the glass, crisp

out.measured: arch top 790 -> 805 (f38) -> 1101 (f39) -> off (f40) @720: split exit, bottom group

build.faceRule: the gap between the panels (x 430-633 at 1080) must contain the face

style-3.rules: Glass covers the body and old words, never the face (the face must sit in the gap between the corner slabs).

components.purpose: Default entrance of the bold hero line (1-3 words).

out.note: 1-frame pre-cut pull-back with the whole composite, then hard cut

components.purpose: Thin (hairline / light) support line typed or faded under or across the hero.

start.note: starts 6-15 f @25 (240-600 ms) after its pill starts, ~400-700 ms after the hero

components.purpose: Bold label typed inside a glass-capsule, starting just after the capsule lands.
Widen a thin Arabic word with repeated tatweel (U+0640) so it spans a partner word, becomes a rule or glows as a line. Never used to justify paragraphs.

params.count: integer (write the tatweels into the text when only one word is stretched)
params.insertAfter: first joining letter that has a joining successor

style-1.rules: Thin words only (one bold exception: the turn word). Tatweels type on as separate dashed units that close with the settle; one long kashida (up to 44% W) becomes a rule into an illustration.

style-2.rules: Widen with kashida, never tracking. In thin weight the stretched kashida glows as a neon line (optional 200 ms glint along it); بعدك wraps 82% W around the gold hero.

out.note: drops with the arch (split exit, bottom group)

style-3.rules: Light or outline words only (bold exception: the turn word with 2). The kashida is drawn like a line by an RTL clip, often behind the head.

components.purpose: The one keyword per section/shot that gets a special surface. Shared rule: at most one special material on screen at a time; everything else is flat white.
components.renderNote: Gradient fills use background-clip:text; put glows, rims and extrusions on an under-layer copy or a wrapper filter: drop-shadow(), never text-shadow on the gradient element.

style-1.rule: exactly one special-material word per section, never two in a shot

fill.space: shared screen-space band x 25.8%..79.0% W for both hook lines (not per word, not per line)

effects.renderHint: gradient fill: draw the glow on a duplicated text layer underneath (or filter: drop-shadow on a wrapper); text-shadow bleeds over background-clip:text

orange3d.use: contrast word on the B&W interrupt

fill.space: element line box with lineHeight 1.2 (alef top at 15.8%, baseline at 77.5%, descender bottom at 97.5%)

rimLight.method: duplicate text in #6AF3F7 offset y -3px, blur 2px, placed under the chrome fill

effects.renderHint: gradient fill: rim + bloom on an under-layer, never text-shadow on the gradient element

style-2.rule: one Arabic hero word per graphic shot (53-86% W), a new material each time; only the gold panel + pill may reprise for the CTA set-up

fauxBold.note: Readex Pro stops at 700; the reference is 800-900. Add a same-tone 4 px stroke.

fill.note: Opacity gradients are static. The left and right alefs fade in opposite directions. The talent's arms show through the glyphs.

style-3.rule: emphasis comes from light, not new hues; at most one device per shot; all accents stay red/pink

fill.space: element (word) box; sampled as glyph-pixel column medians on f30 (x205-531 @720)
fill.optionalBottomShade: alef/right end darkens to #93494D at the bottom (f25); approximate with a second background layer linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(147,73,77,0) 60%, rgba(147,73,77,0.45) 100%) limited to the right 12%

hold.note: background-size 400%: band centre x = (2 - 3p) * lineWidth, so 30% -> just right of the line, 70% -> just left of it. FWHM = 0.16 x line width (~92 px on a 576 px line = measured 55-75 px @720)

pinkSweepBand.use: overlay clone over a white hero; band travels right to left and leaves the letters white

effects.innerGlow: text-shadow of the transparent glyph gives a faint inner fill (#640003 median)

fill.space: element box; inner fill rises from the wall colour (#4F0400) at the top to #8C0000 at the bottom (M stem column, f20)

effects.renderHint: gradient fill + stroke: put the glow on an under-layer copy (text-shadow paints over background-clip:text)

effects.innerBevel: 1 px lighter edge on counters (z_P.png); optional

components.purpose: The one-word pivot ("but" / "if") that turns problem into solution. Every reference has exactly one, built glyph by glyph with a small overshoot or flash.

keyframes.measured: word width 241->371 (peak f232) -> 356-359 @720: +3.6% overshoot, 10 f settle

components.purpose: Huge word in mix-blend-mode: difference, so it changes colour over the plate, props and talent.

params.formula: base = desiredVisible + localPlate (per channel, clipped at 255); the visible colour depends on the plate

components.renderNote: mix-blend-mode only works if no ancestor creates an isolated stacking context (no opacity/transform/filter/isolation on #front).

style-1.reason: Not in the Ember Glass vocabulary: over the orange backdrop a white Difference layer reads blue, which the style forbids.

scriptCyan.note: renders #0DD2C5 over the teal plate and red over white text

style-2.rule: hook hero only; recompute the base colour for any non-teal plate

out.note: 1-frame swap-out at f278; next word arrives on the following frame

style-3.rule: wide shots only, across the torso band, max 2 words in one beat; the only way cool colours appear

components.purpose: A weaker second voice next to the hero: a literal English translation or a ghosted mega-word that overlaps the hero instead of stacking under it.

style-1.reason: Latin appears only in the brand lockup; Arabic and Latin never share a shot outside it.

style-2.rule: English is the literal translation and always the weaker layer (35-90% alpha, centre-hot fade, hairline script or small)

style-3.rule: translucent red mega-word at wall depth behind the hero; never overlaps the talent

components.purpose: Brand name moment.

style-1.placement: MCU chest band, turn + brand beat

style-2.note: No wordmark: the product keyword (gold panel + glass pill + shimmer) is reprised as the CTA set-up inside a pull-back.

style-3.placement: parked above the frame in world space; the pull-back drops it in

components.purpose: Digital zoom-OUT on the first frame of a key shot (all three styles open beats by pulling back, never pushing in).

engine.note: runtime scales #plateWrap + #talentWrap; world-locked cues need a wrapper that copies the camera transform (worldLockSpec)

style-1.when: first frame of each new beat shot (4 of 7 shots); not on the brand MCU, the breather or the closing wide

style-2.when: cut into a key-message WS: hook, feature and CTA set-up (3 of 5 WS)

style-3.when: hook (then settle-float), problem reveal, text-free breather, brand

components.purpose: Static digital crop that turns a wide 4K take into the tight shot of the wide/tight alternation.

style-2.note: Reference MCUs come from a second framing on a longer lens (very shallow DOF); the tight CU is about 1.3x the MCU. Shoot WS + MCU, or crop a 4K WS.

components.purpose: The only transition in all three styles: a hard cut in a speech pause that flips shot size; every caption drops on the cut; no SFX.

style-1.placement: inside a VO pause, 0-300 ms (0-9 f) before the next phrase onset
style-1.overlays: all captions of the outgoing shot drop on the cut
style-1.alternation: wide <-> MCU and world plate <-> studio

style-2.placement: in a speech pause; next phrase starts 1-3 F (33-100 ms) after the cut

style-3.sizeFlip: tight (MS/MCU, head 18-20% H) <-> wide (WS, head 8-10% H): x2-2.6 subject scale; x6-7 out of the extreme wide
style-3.exceptions: 1 of 9 cuts is MS->MS (into the parallax breathing shot)
style-3.placement: speech micro-pause: 4 of 9 within +-45 ms of a voice minimum (5.36 +20, 10.36 +40, 11.72 +10, 14.48 -40 ms), the rest within 70-390 ms
style-3.graphics: every caption leaves on the cut frame (no exit animation)

components.purpose: One mid-reel jolt that resets attention. Use exactly one per video.

style-1.appliesTo: plate + talent + every earlier caption (they become grey ghosts)
style-1.release: hard cut to a sharp full-colour shot, no ramp back
style-1.pairedWith: smoked-pill-autosize + orange3d word, then a clean breather

style-2.reason: No interrupt device: attention is reset by a new hero material on every graphic shot and by long clean MCUs.

style-3.oldWord: becomes frosted and -21% brighter in 2-3 f as the panel passes
style-3.newWord: blur-wipe-in on top, 120 ms after the panels start

wordSwap.in: incoming word blur-ghost-in starts on the next frame

components.purpose: Talking head with zero graphics. All three styles rest the eye; they differ in how often and how long.

style-1.placement: right after the B&W interrupt, before proof + payoff

style-2.placement: only after the first ~16 s; the spoken CTA MCU is also clean

style-3.shot: MS with pullback-slow-parallax + roses, then a locked tight MCU

components.purpose: How the reel ends. None of the three uses a logo card or a fade.

style-1.what: static hold of the chrome payoff word with the CTA capsule and lens rings still on screen

style-2.what: hard-cut end on the spoken CTA (clean MCU, 3.37 s); no card, logo, hold or fade

style-3.what: headline cascade + outline pill + typed label, then hold

components.purpose: Self-animated exits. Shared rule: captions leave on the cut; each style allows one narrow exception.

exception.note: reverse type-off: last glyph first, stacked lines erase together, ~667 ms for 10 glyphs

style-1.where: reverse type-off inside the static closing shot only

style-2.where: never: the hard cut removes every graphic

earlyWordOut.what: first hero word fades out 2 f @25 before the cut so the second word stands alone

style-3.where: hook split exit before the void reveal; first hero word may leave 80 ms before the cut

components.purpose: Background replacement / set look behind the matted talent, plus the style's signature backdrop element.

studioWide.use: full-body wide shots (orange cyc with amber floor band from 80% H)

studioMcu.use: MCU shots (hot spot left of head, near-black top-right)

style-1.signature: AI world plates with depth-sandwich props (badge ribbon, molecule, flask + fog), alternating with the plain orange studio

wsPlate.use: WS when the source set is warm, bright or busy (bg-replace with the person matte)

darkCoolSet.use: source set already dark, cool or neutral: grade (grade.ffmpeg) and add cyan practicals (bloom blobs at the top corners)

style-2.signature: dark teal clinic plate with cyan practicals; teal grid stage under the 3D prop in the hook
style-2.note: a grade cannot turn a warm set teal: replace or relight

voidExtension.use: extreme-wide reveal (the shrunken studio floats in a dark smoky void)

sunburstHalo.contrast: rays only +30-35 R levels over the wall (#6B0505 on #4A0004)
sunburstHalo.scaleWithShot: radius ~105 px @720 in the extreme wide, ~343 in the wide, overflowing the frame in MCU (use perHeadWidth with the face track)

components.purpose: Photoreal or 3D prop (PNG / PNG sequence with alpha) placed in front of or behind the talent for depth.

style-1.rules: props live on the AI world-plate shots; ribbon back arc behind the arm, front arc and flask in front; slow loops only (< 0.5 Hz, molecule 6.9 deg/s)

screen.content: looping video or PNG sequence; animated counter and progress bar #21A4F0

style-2.rules: enters from a frame edge, keeps a slow yaw spin, never exits, unshadowed and ungraded

build.assets: 2 PNGs with alpha; prompt: 'single deep red rose bloom, glossy velvety petals, spiral centre, macro, studio lighting, isolated on transparent background'

in.measured: BL top edge y1099 -> 888, right edge x345 -> 427 @720 while the plate scales x0.58

style-3.rules: foreground props only in text-free shots; they counter-scale against the pull-back

components.purpose: Edge falloff. Captions are never darkened in any style.

vignette.note: mild because the strong falloff lives in the backdrop gradients; disable on bright AI-plate shots; must not darken captions (reference captions stay #FFFFFF at the top band)

build.behindLayer: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 42%, rgba(12,0,0,0) 45%, rgba(12,0,0,0.80) 100%) + linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,0,0,0.6) 0%, rgba(6,0,0,0) 14%)
build.talentMask: #talentWrap mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 86%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 100%) (bottom falls to Y~12 in MCUs)

style-3.rule: never in fx (fx sits above the captions)

components.purpose: Plate/talent grade. Graphics are never graded.

engine.key: grade.css on the plate + talent canvases

style-2.normalize: eq=gamma=G:brightness=B  -> choose G (1.0-1.5) so the face-box median luma before the look curve is about 0.50 (128)

components.purpose: Whether captions/UI are parented to the camera move (the zoom delivers the type) or stay screen-locked.

style-1.what: Captions and glass UI are screen-locked: punch-out-settle / mcu-* scale only #plateWrap and #talentWrap (captions are not scaled). Exceptions that move the whole composite incl. captions: plate-wobble (AI world plates) and the 1-frame precut-pullback.

style-2.what: Text/UI whose preset or component has worldLock:true receives the same transform as the plate during pullback-two-step (same origin, same scale keys), so it shrinks and drops with the camera.
style-2.formula1080: x = ox + (xFinal - ox) * S, y = oy + (yFinal - oy) * S, scale = S, with (ox, oy) = focusPx (540, 787) and S = current camera scale / final camera scale
style-2.measuredFit: hero height 243 -> 187 px (@720) in step 2 while the camera ratio is 0.795
style-2.runtimeNote: the engine scales only #plateWrap and #talentWrap; wrap world-locked cues in a container driven by the camera tween

style-3.what: Captions/logos/sunburst marked worldLock:true ride the camera move (they are parented to the zooming comp in the reference).
style-3.formula1080: x = 540 + (xFinal - 540) * S, y = 960 + (yFinal - 960) * S, scale = S, where S = current camera scale / final camera scale
style-3.measuredFit: 'استاذي' top within 5-13 px, PRIME top within +-5 px of the prediction (720 frame, centre 640)
style-3.runtimeNote: engine/compositor applies cameraMoves only to #plateWrap and #talentWrap. Implement cameraLocked in style-3 components.js with an onFrame hook that copies gsap.getProperty('#plateWrap','scale'/'x'/'y') and transformOrigin onto a wrapper around the locked element.

components.purpose: Sparse, tonal, high-frequency accents tied to text/graphic events. Shared rule: nothing on cuts or camera moves; no whooshes, risers or impacts; sync to speech, not beats.

engine.key: sfx[] rules (event/preset/sound/offsetMs/gainDb); idealSound names a soundSpecs entry for a style synth

style-1.policy: No whooshes, risers, impacts or pops on cuts or graphics. Speech drives timing. Only optional sparkle: paired ~8.36 kHz pings 300 ms apart on three reveals.

ping8k.confidence: medium (spectrogram only; needs a listening check)

style-2.policy: Sparse, tonal SFX tied to a graphic type (gold shimmer, glass chime, near-inaudible ticks on type-ons). No whoosh, impact or riser on cuts or pull-backs. No music bed.

rules.measured: 9252 Hz 5.17-5.27 s, 5597 Hz 5.27-5.33 s; reused at 29.55 s. Band level -32..-41 dBFS vs speech about -12 dBFS. Lands on the first glyph (S3) or on the outer glyphs (S9, +200 ms).
8.1 kHz ticks 6.18-6.46 / 6.75-6.85 s plus a 4.0 kHz event 6.58-6.72 s; band level about -57 dBFS (barely audible)
7.21 kHz at 30.72-31.03 and 31.20 s, about -48 dBFS; one per word
11.40-11.88 s, the loudest SFX: 4.09 kHz partial about -25 dBFS. Starts 1 F before the cut into the UI shot.

rules.condition: only when the shot carries visionos-glass-ui

style-3.policy: Voice-first. No whooshes/risers/impacts on cuts or pull-backs. SFX only on text events: typing rattle (first typed subtitle), tick (1 f before the cut into the turn word), pop + ding on the turn word glyphs. Optional click when the arch lands.

typingRattleHF.desc: train of tiny transients above 11 kHz, one every 22-46 ms (~22 Hz), 480 ms long, +40 dB over the HF band median

tickHF.desc: 6.64 kHz tonal tick + broadband >11 kHz burst, ~50 ms

popHF.desc: short pop with spectral peak ~10-10.7 kHz, ~90 ms

ding4k.desc: 4.19 kHz fundamental + 8.38 kHz partial (partial 2.6 dB louder), decays ~25 dB by 220 ms, ~300 ms ring

rules.note: only the first typed subtitle of the reel gets typing audio (3.61-4.09 s)
one frame before the cut into the pop shot (8.62-8.66 s)
at peak growth of the first glyph (8.71-8.80 s)
100 ms after the second glyph starts (onset 9.10 s), leads into the bell
as the arch lands and its line starts typing (0.98 s); low confidence

components.purpose: Music under the voice. Never beat-synced in any style.

style-1.character: light stepping bass/pluck ostinato, no hits, drops or swells

style-2.character: none: dialogue-led mix (speech RMS p50 -17.8 dBFS)
style-2.note: No music bed detected. Dialogue-led. Room tone about -30 dBFS (50 Hz hum) is incidental; do not add.

style-3.character: sustained sub-bass pad/bass line, fundamental 41 Hz (E1) with harmonics 82/123 Hz, no drum grid
phraseChangesAt: just before a cut into a difference/question beat (9.85-10.40 s, ~100 Hz note)
around the cut out of the brand shot (20.3-21.4 s, ~90 -> 70 Hz)
